headline: OpenAI Cuts Fundraising Target by $10 Billion, FT Reports
summary: OpenAI has reduced its fundraising target by $10 billion, according to a Financial Times report.
why: As a major player in artificial intelligence, OpenAI's capital-raising activities reflect broader venture capital liquidity trends and the massive capital expenditure requirements of developing frontier AI models.
